venues.name: D&C DC
venues.weather: Gloomy start, rain never came in and stayed pretty decent out
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Sunday 3/15.** Strong Sunday; beat the sales goal and the team made good guest connections. Room close to full ~7 to 9:30, then a few guests and lights out by 10:30. The late Sunday pop keeps happening a bit earlier each week. Kitchen: slower than most Sundays at 15.7% of sales, mostly fried chicken and chips and dip. MOD: Jamal/Alex.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Sunday 3/15.** Date-leaning flow (2.29 guests/party) with consistent volume until 11:30, when it dropped to silence. Peter's speed charger saved a phone-dead guest's night. New SevenRooms helps hosts see table order status; Haleigh anticipated guest outflows well. Many newcomers, post-Met and post-marathon groups, southern Indiana guests. 1 large party, 8 solos, ~4 investor cocktails. Comps $81.88 (mostly related to kitchen issues). Top sellers: Cielo Asilo, Year of the Trees, Material Control. Kitchen: breaker continually shorting; chef and Cara working to resolve. Door: lively Sunday, full by 7pm with brief wait; groups after the NYC half marathon; 10pm wave of medium friend groups, two birthdays; another wave of twos at 11:30. No-shows: Koen Storm 2 @ 9:30pm; Amy Marona 3 @ 10pm. Repairs: repairs scheduled for tomorrow; question about why books are no longer signed.
